test_layout_topk: test the LayoutPredictor top-k confidence scores for detected layout boxes on a test image
test_layout_bboxes: test that LayoutPredictor returns correct bounding box labels like SectionHeader and Text
test_layout_image_bbox: test that LayoutPredictor reports the correct image bounding box dimensions
test_layout_results_length: test that LayoutPredictor returns one result per input image
test_layout_topk_count: test that each detected layout box contains 5 top-k confidence entries
